blocks.text: Globe Telecom introduced a new way for Filipinos to explore artificial intelligence (AI), making some of the world’s leading AI tools accessible through its newly announced Globe Free AI Fiesta. The announcement took center stage during the quarterly media event, The Blueprint by Globe Holiday Edition last November 9, 2026, which brought together Globe executives, media partners, and industry stakeholders to look back on the company’s milestones in 2026 and explore the innovations lined up for the holiday season.
